submission.justification:
Absorber-F2 with 6mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.102% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents a systematic exploration of the design space:

1. All three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) were evaluated at baseline 5mm thickness, showing F2 had superior performance (3.2%) compared to F3 (3.9%) and F1 (5.1%).

2. Thickness optimization was performed for F2, testing values at 2mm, 3mm, 4mm, 5mm, 6mm, 7mm, and 8mm. The results show an optimal point at 6mm with 3.102% resolution.

3. F2 at 6mm satisfies all constraints:
   - Material is from the approved candidate list
   - Plate thickness of 6mm falls within the 2-10mm range
   - The material properties support hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
   - Delivers the best achievable energy resolution for the specified design goal

The 6mm thickness represents an optimal balance - thinner plates would compromise resolution, while thicker plates show degraded performance due to sampling effects. This configuration provides the forward electromagnetic calorimeter with optimal performance for precision physics measurements at the collider.
